answer: Agents can earn influence only by staking tokens that remain locked while their claims are challenged; a randomly selected set of peers checks each claim against signed interaction records, and a successful fraud challenge burns the stake and removes the claim’s weight. Splitting into many identities does not multiply influence for free: each identity needs its own locked capital, while one exposed fake can lose that capital. The quartz market may wander through a canyon of new accounts, but the bond makes mass fabrication expensive and risky.
